parts.name: base frame

physics.Basic_description: The bottom half of the case, appearing as a rigid, matte grey-blue plastic tray with raised edges.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the CD hub and provides the structural base for the case assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the outer rim or side walls of the base to lift or stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic shell enclosing air volume; standard jewel case construction.

parts.description: The bottom half of the case, appearing as a rigid, matte grey-blue plastic tray with raised edges.
parts.function: Holds the CD hub and provides the structural base for the case assembly.

parts.name: pivot post 0

physics.Basic_description: Small cylindrical posts located at the hinge area, matching the base material color.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the pivot point for the flip tray mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to be grasped directly; avoided during manipulation.
physics.reason: Small structural pins are typically solid plastic to withstand shear forces.

parts.name: lid shell

physics.Basic_description: The top cover of the case, a large flat rectangular panel of matte grey-blue plastic.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the contents and closes the case securely.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the edge or corner of the lid to open the case or lift the entire object.
physics.reason: Thin-walled injection molded cover; interior is air.

parts.name: tray panel

physics.Basic_description: A lighter grey/white plastic panel that flips over, slightly flexible in appearance.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the booklet or second disc and flips to reveal the main disc.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the free edge of the tray to flip it open or closed.
physics.reason: Thin flexible sheet structure typical of CD tray inserts.

parts.name: hub face 0

physics.Basic_description: Small orange-tinted central hub components on the flip tray.
physics.Functional_description: Snaps into the CD center hole to secure the disc on the flip tray.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; too small and central to the mechanism.
physics.reason: Small functional clips are generally solid or thick-walled enough to treat as solid for mass estimation.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
